HOST.description: HTTP bind address. Keep 0.0.0.0 so Railway can reach the service.

DATA_DIR.description: Data dir for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

USERNAME.description: Username for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

PASSWORD.description: Generated password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

NO_AUTH.description: No auth for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for mikochi. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for mikochi. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for mikochi. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
